config:
[accounts]
active = "full"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "full"
name = "Full Record"
harness = "claude"
auth = "api_key"
priority = 3
route = "zai/glm-5.3"
account_id = "acct-full"
tags = ["work", "it's"]
description = "the full record"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "keyed"
name = "Keyed"
harness = "openclaw"
auth = "api_key"
[accounts.records.env]
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "${KEYCHAIN:item-a}"
ZED = "plain"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "oauth"
name = "OAuth"
harness = "claude"
auth = "oauth_dir"
credentials_source = "{TMP}/creds"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "alt"
name = "Alt"
harness = "claude"
auth = "managed"
config_dir = "{TMP}/alt"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "makers"
name = "makers"
harness = "claude"
auth = "managed"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "ready"
name = "ready"
harness = "claude"
auth = "managed"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "cx"
name = "cx"
harness = "codex"
auth = "managed"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "z"
name = "z"
harness = "claude"
auth = "api_key"
[accounts.records.env]
ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${ENV:SHOW_TOKEN}"

expect.stdout:
id:                  keyed
name:                Keyed
harness:             openclaw
auth:                api_key
priority:            100
env:                 {'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY': '${KEYCHAIN:item-a}', 'ZED': 'plain'}
account_id:          keyed
